guide.summary: 连 X 都/也 means 'even X': it picks the most extreme case and says the statement holds even there. 连 goes right before the thing that is surprising, that thing moves in front of the verb, and 都 or 也 must follow it. Think of 连 and 都/也 as two halves of a frame: X sits inside, and everything else (不, 没, the verb) comes after 都/也.

subs.label: 都 / 也 cannot be left out
subs.focus: Learner must supply 都/也 after the 连 phrase (or 连 to open the frame). Classic error: 连 alone for 'even' (连他知道). Never set 都 against 也: both are right. Cloze distractors: 就, 才, 只, ∅; not 还, since 连…还 can occur.

subs.label: 连 + subject
subs.focus: The doer is the surprise: 连 before the subject, 都/也 after it, before the predicate. Classic errors: 连 after the subject (他连也来了) or 都/也 before the subject. A topic may come first (这个字连老师都不认识). The English cue must show the subject is the surprise.

subs.label: 连 + fronted object
subs.focus: The object is the surprise: it must move with 连 in front of 都/也 and the verb. Classic error: English order (他没吃连早饭, 他连都没吃早饭). The 连 phrase may follow or precede the subject (他连早饭都没吃 / 连早饭他都没吃): order items need the other as alt.

subs.label: 连 + verb + 都/也 + 没/不 + verb
subs.focus: 'Didn't even look': bare verb after 连, repeated after 都/也 + 没/不; 了/过/object/就 clause go with the second copy. Learner must decide to repeat the verb. Classic errors: no repetition (他连没看就走了) or a positive predicate. Keep items negative.

subs.label: 连 + 一 + measure + 都/也 + negative
subs.focus: 'Not even one': 一 + measure (+ noun) before 都/也, predicate negative. Learner picks the fronted position, the negation, a fitting measure. Classic errors: phrase left after the verb (没有连一个人), 都/也 missing. 连 is optional here, so never make ∅ for 连 a wrong option.

subs.label: 不 / 没 comes after 都 / 也
subs.focus: Learner must put 不/没 directly after 都/也, before the verb or auxiliary. Classic errors: negating before 都 (他连手机没都带) or in front of 连. In order items cut 都/也 and 不/没 as separate tiles. Do not hinge an item on 不 versus 没 unless time reference clearly forces one.

subs.label: 一点儿也不 / 一点儿都没: not at all
subs.focus: 'Not at all': 一点儿 + 也/都 + 不/没 + adjective/verb, or 一点儿 + noun + 也/都 + 没有. Learner must put 一点儿 before 也/都 and the negation and not confuse it with positive 有点儿. Classic errors: 我不累一点儿, 我有点儿也不累, positive use. Never set 也 against 都.

rules.rule: 连 never works alone. Whatever follows 连 must be followed by 都 or 也, and only then comes the rest of the sentence.

examples.zh: 连我妈妈都知道这件事。
examples.py: lián wǒ mā ma dōu zhī dào zhè jiàn shì
examples.en: Even my mum knows about this.

examples.py: tā lián xīng qī tiān yě shàng bān
examples.en: He works even on Sundays.

examples.py: wǒ máng de lián fàn dōu wàng le chī
examples.en: I was so busy I even forgot to eat.

rules.note: 都 and 也 mean the same here and both are always acceptable; 也 is heard a little more often in negative sentences. Use one of them, never both together.

rules.rule: If the surprising thing is who does it, put 连 in front of the subject and 都/也 right after the subject.
rules.pattern: 连 + Subject + 都/也 + Verb / Adjective

examples.py: lián xiǎo hái zi dōu zhī dào
examples.en: Even little kids know that.

examples.py: lián tā yě chí dào le
examples.en: Even he was late.

examples.zh: 这个字连老师都不认识。
examples.py: zhè ge zì lián lǎo shī dōu bù rèn shi
examples.en: Even the teacher doesn't know this character.

rules.note: What the sentence is about can be stated first as a topic, as in the last example; 连 still stands directly before the surprising subject.

rules.rule: If the surprising thing is the object, it cannot stay after the verb. Move it in front of the verb together with 连, then add 都/也.
rules.pattern: Subject + 连 + Object + 都/也 + Verb

examples.py: tā lián zǎo fàn dōu méi chī
examples.en: He didn't even eat breakfast.

examples.py: wǒ lián tā de míng zi dōu wàng le
examples.en: I've even forgotten his name.

examples.zh: 她连自己的生日也不记得。
examples.py: tā lián zì jǐ de shēng rì yě bù jì de
examples.en: She doesn't even remember her own birthday.

rules.rule: The 连 + object phrase may also go before the subject. The subject then stands between the object and 都/也.
rules.pattern: 连 + Object + Subject + 都/也 + Verb

examples.zh: 连这么简单的题他都不会。
examples.py: lián zhè me jiǎn dān de tí tā dōu bù huì
examples.en: He can't even do a question this simple.

examples.py: lián zǎo fàn tā dōu méi chī
examples.en: He didn't even eat breakfast.

rules.note: Both orders mean the same. Subject first is the more common one; object first puts a bit more weight on the object.

rules.rule: To say someone did not even do the action, put the bare verb after 连 and say the verb again after 都/也 + 没/不. 了, 过, an object or a following 就 clause go with the second verb, never the first.
rules.pattern: Subject + 连 + Verb + 都/也 + 没/不 + Verb

examples.py: tā lián kàn dōu méi kàn jiù zǒu le
examples.en: He left without even looking.

examples.zh: 这个地方我连听都没听说过。
examples.py: zhè ge dì fang wǒ lián tīng dōu méi tīng shuō guo
examples.en: I've never even heard of this place.

examples.zh: 他连问都不问就拿走了。
examples.py: tā lián wèn dōu bù wèn jiù ná zǒu le
examples.en: He took it without even asking.

rules.note: This verb-copying form is used almost only with a negative predicate.

rules.rule: 'Not even one': put 一 + measure word (+ noun) before 都/也, and make the predicate negative.
rules.pattern: 连 + 一 + Measure + Noun + 都/也 + 没/不 + Verb

examples.zh: 教室里连一个人都没有。
examples.py: jiào shì lǐ lián yī gè rén dōu méi yǒu
examples.en: There isn't even one person in the classroom.

examples.py: tā lián yī jù huà yě méi shuō
examples.en: He didn't say even one word.

examples.py: wǒ lián yī fēn zhōng dōu bù xiǎng děng
examples.en: I don't want to wait even one minute.

rules.note: With 一 + measure, 连 itself may be dropped with no change in meaning (教室里一个人都没有), but 都/也 and the negation must stay.

rules.rule: 不 and 没 go after 都/也, directly before the verb or the auxiliary. Nothing negative goes between 连 and 都/也.
rules.pattern: 连 + X + 都/也 + 不/没 + Verb

examples.py: tā lián shǒu jī dōu méi dài
examples.en: He didn't even bring his phone.

examples.py: tā lián kā fēi yě bù hē
examples.en: She doesn't even drink coffee.

examples.zh: 连经理都不知道这件事。
examples.py: lián jīng lǐ dōu bù zhī dào zhè jiàn shì
examples.en: Even the manager doesn't know about this.

rules.note: The choice between 不 and 没 follows the normal rules: 没 for something that did not happen, 不 for habits, wishes and states.

rules.rule: 'Not at all': 一点儿 comes first, then 也/都, then 不/没, then the adjective or verb.
rules.pattern: Subject + 一点儿 + 也/都 + 不/没 + Adjective / Verb

examples.py: wǒ yī diǎn r yě bù lèi
examples.en: I'm not tired at all.

examples.py: zhè ge cài yī diǎn r dōu bù là
examples.en: This dish isn't spicy at all.

examples.zh: 这么多年他一点儿都没变。
examples.py: zhè me duō nián tā yī diǎn r dōu méi biàn
examples.en: He hasn't changed a bit in all these years.

rules.note: This pattern is always negative. The positive 'a bit tired' is 有点儿累, a different word. In casual speech 也/都 is sometimes dropped (一点儿不累), but learn and write it with 也/都.

rules.rule: 'Not even a little of something': 一点儿 + noun goes before 也/都 and the negative verb, like a fronted object.
rules.pattern: Subject + 一点儿 + Noun + 也/都 + 没/不 + Verb

examples.py: wǒ yī diǎn r qián dōu méi yǒu
examples.en: I don't have any money at all.

examples.py: tā yī diǎn r dōng xi yě méi chī
examples.en: He didn't eat anything at all.

examples.zh: 我今天一点儿时间都没有。
examples.py: wǒ jīn tiān yī diǎn r shí jiān dōu méi yǒu
examples.en: I don't have any time at all today.

rules.note: 连 can be added in front for extra force: 我连一点儿钱都没有.

right.py: lián xiǎo hái zi dōu zhī dào

contrasts.why: English 'even' is one word, but 连 needs its partner: 都 or 也 must follow the 连 phrase.

right.py: tā lián zǎo fàn dōu méi chī

contrasts.why: The object marked by 连 cannot stay after the verb. It moves in front of the verb and is followed by 都/也.

right.py: tā lián shǒu jī dōu méi dài
right.en: He didn't even bring his phone.

contrasts.why: The negation comes after 都/也, directly before the verb. 没都 breaks the 连…都 frame.

right.py: lián tā yě chí dào le

contrasts.why: 连 stands directly before the surprising element. Here that is the subject 他, so 连 comes first and 也 follows 他.

right.py: tā lián kàn dōu méi kàn jiù zǒu le

contrasts.why: When the verb is the focus, it appears twice: bare after 连, and again after 都 + 没.

right.zh: 教室里连一个人都没有。
right.py: jiào shì lǐ lián yī gè rén dōu méi yǒu
right.en: There isn't even one person in the classroom.

contrasts.why: 'Not even one' puts 一个人 before 都 and the negative verb, not after 没有.

right.py: wǒ yī diǎn r yě bù lèi

contrasts.why: 'At all' comes last in English, but 一点儿 goes first, followed by 也/都 and then 不.

right.py: wǒ yī diǎn r yě bù lèi

contrasts.why: 有点儿 is the positive 'a bit' (有点儿累). The negative 'not at all' pattern uses 一点儿 + 也/都 + 不.

cheat: See 连? 都 or 也 must follow its phrase. No partner, no sentence.
连 sits directly in front of the surprising thing: the subject, the object, the verb, or 一 + measure.
Surprising object: pull it in front of the verb. Nothing marked by 连 stays after the verb.
不 / 没 always comes after 都 / 也, right before the verb.
Didn't even do it: 连 + verb + 都 + 没 + same verb (连看都没看).
Not even one: 一 + measure + 都/也 + negative; 连 in front is optional.
Not at all: 一点儿 + 也/都 + 不/没. Positive 'a bit' is 有点儿, never mix them.

items.zh: 连我奶奶都会用手机付钱。
items.en: Even my grandma can pay with her phone.
items.why: 连我奶奶 is the surprising subject, so it opens the sentence with 都 right after it. 连 cannot come after the subject.
items.py: lián wǒ nǎi nǎi dōu huì yòng shǒu jī fù qián

items.q: 这家饭店的菜一点儿___不贵。
items.zh: 这家饭店的菜一点儿也不贵。
items.en: The dishes in this restaurant aren't expensive at all.
items.why: 'Not at all' is 一点儿 + 也 (or 都) + 不 + adjective. 有, 就 and 才 cannot replace 也 in this frame.
items.py: zhè jiā fàn diàn de cài yī diǎn r yě bù guì

items.s: 他连邻居的名字也记不住。
items.s_py: tā lián lín jū de míng zi yě jì bù zhù
items.zh: 他连邻居的名字也记不住。
items.en: He can't even remember his neighbours' names.
items.why: The negation is inside the potential complement 记不住, after 也, so this is correct.
items.py: tā lián lín jū de míng zi yě jì bù zhù

items.s_py: shāng diàn lǐ méi yǒu lián yī gè rén
items.zh: 商店里连一个人都没有。
items.en: There isn't even one person in the shop.
items.why: 连一个人 must come before 都 and the negative verb. It cannot follow 没有.
items.py: shāng diàn lǐ lián yī gè rén dōu méi yǒu

items.src_py: wǒ jīn tiān yǒu yī diǎn r shí jiān
items.task: Say I have no time at all today.
items.zh: 我今天一点儿时间都没有。
items.en: I don't have any time at all today.
items.why: 一点儿时间 is fronted before 都 and 没有. The time word 今天 may come before or after 我.
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān yī diǎn r shí jiān dōu méi yǒu

items.s_py: lǎo bǎn lián yě bù zhī dào jià qián
items.zh: 连老板也不知道价钱。
items.en: Even the boss doesn't know the price.
items.why: 连 must stand directly before the surprising subject 老板. 连也 is not possible.
items.py: lián lǎo bǎn yě bù zhī dào jià qián

items.q: 我家附近连一家超市___没有。
items.zh: 我家附近连一家超市都没有。
items.en: There isn't even one supermarket near my home.
items.why: 连一家超市 is followed by 都 and 没有. 就, 才 and 只 do not belong to the 连 frame.
items.py: wǒ jiā fù jìn lián yī jiā chāo shì dōu méi yǒu

items.s: 超市里一点儿肉也没有了。
items.s_py: chāo shì lǐ yī diǎn r ròu yě méi yǒu le
items.zh: 超市里一点儿肉也没有了。
items.en: There isn't any meat at all in the supermarket.
items.why: 一点儿 + noun goes before 也 and 没有, like a fronted object. This is correct.
items.py: chāo shì lǐ yī diǎn r ròu yě méi yǒu le

items.s_py: tā méi mǎi lián niú nǎi
items.zh: 他连牛奶都没买。
items.en: He didn't even buy milk.
items.why: The 连 object must move before 都 and the verb. It cannot stay after 没买.
items.py: tā lián niú nǎi dōu méi mǎi

items.q: 这个小区很安静，连晚上___听不到车声。
items.zh: 这个小区很安静，连晚上也听不到车声。
items.en: This compound is so quiet that you can't hear cars even at night.
items.why: 连晚上 needs 也 (or 都) after it. Leaving the slot empty breaks the frame, and 只 or 就 cannot stand in for the second half of 连…也.
items.py: zhè ge xiǎo qū hěn ān jìng lián wǎn shàng yě tīng bù dào chē shēng

items.q: 他今天连手机___带，所以没法付钱。
items.zh: 他今天连手机都没带，所以没法付钱。
items.en: He didn't even bring his phone today, so he can't pay.
items.why: 都 comes first and 没 follows it, directly before the verb: 连手机都没带. Putting 没 before 都 (没都) breaks the frame.
items.py: tā jīn tiān lián shǒu jī dōu méi dài suǒ yǐ méi fǎ fù qián

items.q: 这双鞋太贵了，连我爸爸___不想买。
items.zh: 这双鞋太贵了，连我爸爸都不想买。
items.en: These shoes are too expensive; even my dad doesn't want to buy them.
items.why: 连我爸爸 must be followed by 都 or 也 to complete 'even'. 就 and 才 are timing words and 只 means 'only', so none of them can partner 连.
items.py: zhè shuāng xié tài guì le lián wǒ bà bà dōu bù xiǎng mǎi

items.src: 经理亲自来帮我们搬家了。
items.src_py: jīng lǐ qīn zì lái bāng wǒ men bān jiā le
items.task: Say even the manager came in person, with 连 and 都.
items.zh: 连经理都亲自来帮我们搬家了。
items.en: Even the manager came in person to help us move.
items.why: 连经理 is the surprising subject, followed by 都 before 亲自 and the rest of the predicate.
items.py: lián jīng lǐ dōu qīn zì lái bāng wǒ men bān jiā le

items.src_py: zhè ge yuè fáng dōng méi lái guò
items.task: Say the landlord hasn't come even once this month, with 连一次.
items.zh: 这个月房东连一次都没来过。
items.en: The landlord hasn't come even once this month.
items.why: 连一次 sits before 都 and 没 来过. The time word 这个月 may come before or after 房东.
items.py: zhè ge yuè fáng dōng lián yī cì dōu méi lái guò

items.q: 那家商店的服务员连价钱___肯告诉我，更别说打折了。
items.zh: 那家商店的服务员连价钱都不肯告诉我，更别说打折了。
items.en: The shop assistant wouldn't even tell me the price, never mind give a discount.
items.why: With the verb phrase 肯告诉我, 不 follows 都: 连价钱都不肯告诉我. 不都 and 不也 put 不 before the particle, and 没都 does the same.
items.py: nà jiā shāng diàn de fú wù yuán lián jià qián dōu bù kěn gào sù wǒ gèng bié shuō dǎ zhé le

items.zh: 我弟弟连牛奶也不喝。
items.en: My younger brother doesn't even drink milk.
items.why: 不 comes after 也 and directly before 喝. 不 cannot be placed before 也.
items.py: wǒ dì di lián niú nǎi yě bù hē

items.q: 这件衣服___点儿也不贵。
items.zh: 这件衣服一点儿也不贵。
items.en: This piece of clothing isn't expensive at all.
items.why: The pattern for 'not at all' is 一点儿也不, with 一. 有点儿 means 'a bit' and cannot combine with 也不.
items.py: zhè jiàn yī fu yī diǎn r yě bù guì

items.zh: 这么贵的房子我连想都不敢想。
items.en: I wouldn't even dare to think about such an expensive house.
items.why: 连想都不敢想 repeats the verb 想, with 不 敢 between 都 and the second 想. The object 这么贵的房子 may be fronted as topic (before or after 我) or stay at the end.
items.py: zhè me guì de fáng zi wǒ lián xiǎng dōu bù gǎn xiǎng

items.src: 我连这个价钱也能接受。
items.src_py: wǒ lián zhè ge jià qián yě néng jiē shòu
items.task: Make it negative.
items.zh: 我连这个价钱也不能接受。
items.en: I can't even accept this price.
items.why: 不 goes after 也 and before the auxiliary 能. It cannot go before 也.
items.py: wǒ lián zhè ge jià qián yě bù néng jiē shòu

items.zh: 我连一分钱都没花。
items.en: I didn't spend even one cent.
items.why: 连一分钱 + 都 + 没 花. The negation follows 都 and the amount precedes it.
items.py: wǒ lián yī fēn qián dōu méi huā

items.q: 我们小区车位太少，连周末___找不到停车位。
items.zh: 我们小区车位太少，连周末都找不到停车位。
items.en: There are so few parking spaces in our compound that you can't find one even at weekends.
items.why: 连周末 is the extreme case, so 都 must follow it before 找不到. 才 and 就 describe timing, and 只 would mean 'only at weekends', the opposite of 'even'.
items.py: wǒ men xiǎo qū chē wèi tài shǎo lián zhōu mò dōu zhǎo bù dào tíng chē wèi

items.zh: 小王连新房子都不想看。
items.en: Xiao Wang doesn't even want to look at the new house.
items.why: 不 comes after 都 and before the auxiliary 想: 都 不 想 看. 不 cannot go before 都.
items.py: xiǎo wáng lián xīn fáng zi dōu bù xiǎng kàn

items.zh: 他连这个月的房租也没交。
items.en: He hasn't even paid this month's rent.
items.why: The 连 object phrase goes before the verb, followed by 也 and then 没 交. The subject may come before or after the 连 phrase.
items.py: tā lián zhè ge yuè de fáng zū yě méi jiāo

items.q: 我连他的电话号码___不知道。
items.zh: 我连他的电话号码也不知道。
items.en: I don't even know his phone number.
items.why: 连他的电话号码 is the fronted object and 也 follows it before 不知道. 就, 才 and 只 cannot complete the frame.
items.py: wǒ lián tā de diàn huà hào mǎ yě bù zhī dào

items.zh: 这个月我连一天都没休息。
items.en: I haven't rested even one day this month.
items.why: 连一天 comes before 都 and 没 休息. The time word 这个月 may come before or after 我.
items.py: zhè ge yuè wǒ lián yī tiān dōu méi xiū xī

items.q: 我___新房子的钥匙都还没拿到，怎么搬进去？
items.zh: 我连新房子的钥匙都还没拿到，怎么搬进去？
items.en: I haven't even got the keys to the new flat yet; how can I move in?
items.why: The object 新房子的钥匙 is moved before 都 and marked with 连, giving 'not even the keys'. 把 would need a verb that handles the object, and 对 and 被 do not fit at all.
items.py: wǒ lián xīn fáng zi de yào shi dōu hái méi ná dào zěn me bān jìn qù

items.zh: 这家商店连节假日都照常营业。
items.en: This shop opens as usual even on public holidays.
items.why: 连节假日 sits before 都 and the predicate. 都 cannot be dropped and cannot precede 连节假日.
items.py: zhè jiā shāng diàn lián jié jià rì dōu zhào cháng yíng yè

items.q: 他连看都没看___走了。
items.zh: 他连看都没看就走了。
items.en: He left without even looking.
items.why: The clause after the 连V都没V frame is joined with 就: 'didn't even look, just left'. 才 would mean he left only after, 只 means 'only', and 都 cannot repeat.
items.py: tā lián kàn dōu méi kàn jiù zǒu le

items.s: 连房东也觉得这个房租太高了。
items.s_py: lián fáng dōng yě jué de zhè ge fáng zū tài gāo le
items.zh: 连房东也觉得这个房租太高了。
items.en: Even the landlord thinks the rent is too high.

items.zh: 我这个周末一点儿时间都没有。
items.en: I don't have any time at all this weekend.
items.why: 一点儿时间 is fronted before 都 and 没有, like a 连 object. The time word 这个周末 may be before or after 我.
items.py: wǒ zhè ge zhōu mò yī diǎn r shí jiān dōu méi yǒu

items.src: 小孩子也知道这个价钱。
items.src_py: xiǎo hái zi yě zhī dào zhè ge jià qián
items.task: Say 'even little kids know the price' with 连.
items.zh: 连小孩子也知道这个价钱。
items.en: Even little kids know the price.
items.why: 连 goes before 小孩子 to stress the extreme case, and 也 must follow it. The topic 这个价钱 can come first.
items.py: lián xiǎo hái zi yě zhī dào zhè ge jià qián

items.q: 他___早饭都没吃就去上班了。
items.zh: 他连早饭都没吃就去上班了。
items.en: He went to work without even eating breakfast.
items.why: 连 introduces the fronted object 早饭, which then takes 都 and 没吃. 把, 给 and 对 cannot be followed by 都 and a negated bare verb here.
items.py: tā lián zǎo fàn dōu méi chī jiù qù shàng bān le

items.q: 这个月我们店的生意不太好，连平时很忙的星期六___没几个客人。
items.zh: 这个月我们店的生意不太好，连平时很忙的星期六也没几个客人。
items.en: Business has been poor this month; even Saturday, normally very busy, hasn't had many customers.
items.why: The 连 phrase 连…星期六 needs 也 or 都 right after it. 就 and 才 add timing meanings and 只 would turn 'even' into 'only'.
items.py: zhè ge yuè wǒ men diàn de shēng yì bù tài hǎo lián píng shí hěn máng de xīng qī liù yě méi jǐ gè kè rén

items.q: 我今天一点儿钱___没有，不能请你吃饭。
items.zh: 我今天一点儿钱都没有，不能请你吃饭。
items.en: I don't have any money at all today, so I can't treat you to a meal.
items.why: 一点儿钱 is fronted and followed by 都 (or 也) and 没有: 'not even a bit of money'. 就, 才 and 只 do not fit the pattern.
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān yī diǎn r qián dōu méi yǒu bù néng qǐng nǐ chī fàn

items.src: 他不记得自己的手机号码。
items.src_py: tā bù jì de zì jǐ de shǒu jī hào mǎ
items.task: Say he doesn't even remember his own number, with 连…也.
items.zh: 他连自己的手机号码也不记得。
items.en: He doesn't even remember his own phone number.
items.why: 连自己的手机号码 is fronted before 也 and 不记得. Nothing marked by 连 remains after the verb.
items.py: tā lián zì jǐ de shǒu jī hào mǎ yě bù jì de

items.q: 连小王___没带钱，我们今天只能不买了。
items.zh: 连小王也没带钱，我们今天只能不买了。
items.en: Even Xiao Wang didn't bring any money, so we can't buy it today.
items.why: 连小王 is the surprising subject, followed directly by 也 and the negative predicate 没带钱. 才, 就 and 只 do not pair with 连.
items.py: lián xiǎo wáng yě méi dài qián wǒ men jīn tiān zhǐ néng bù mǎi le

items.src: 商场里没有便宜的衣服。
items.src_py: shāng chǎng lǐ méi yǒu pián yi de yī fu
items.task: Say there isn't even one cheap piece of clothing in the mall, with 连一件.
items.zh: 商场里连一件便宜的衣服都没有。
items.en: There isn't even one cheap piece of clothing in the mall.
items.why: 一件便宜的衣服 moves before 都 and 没有 with 连. It cannot stay after the verb.
items.py: shāng chǎng lǐ lián yī jiàn pián yi de yī fu dōu méi yǒu

items.zh: 他连一句话也没说。
items.en: He didn't say even one word.
items.why: 连一句话 is fronted before 也 and 没 说. 一句话 cannot follow 说 in this 'not even one' pattern.
items.py: tā lián yī jù huà yě méi shuō

items.q: 这个月我太忙了，连房租___忘了交。
items.zh: 这个月我太忙了，连房租都忘了交。
items.en: I've been so busy this month that I even forgot to pay the rent.
items.why: 连房租 is the surprising object placed before the verb, and 都 must follow it before 忘了交. 才 and 就 do not work with 连, and 只 would flip the meaning.
items.py: zhè ge yuè wǒ tài máng le lián fáng zū dōu wàng le jiāo

items.src_py: wǒ méi tīng shuō guò zhè ge dì fāng
items.task: Say I haven't even heard of this place (focus on the verb 听).
items.zh: 我连听都没听说过这个地方。
items.en: I haven't even heard of this place.
items.why: 连听 都 没 听说过: the verb is repeated after 都 没, with the full form 听说过. The object may be fronted.
items.py: wǒ lián tīng dōu méi tīng shuō guò zhè ge dì fāng

items.q: 这个价格连经理___觉得太低，别人就更不用说了。
items.zh: 这个价格连经理都觉得太低，别人就更不用说了。
items.en: Even the manager thinks this price is too low, never mind everyone else.
items.why: After 连 + subject comes 都 (or 也), then the predicate. 就 and 才 are timing words; 只 would say only the manager thinks so, which clashes with 别人就更不用说.
items.py: zhè ge jià gé lián jīng lǐ dōu jué de tài dī bié ren jiù gèng bù yòng shuō le

items.s: 他连没看就把东西买了。
items.s_py: tā lián méi kàn jiù bǎ dōng xi mǎi le
items.zh: 他连看都没看就把东西买了。
items.en: He bought the things without even looking.
items.why: The verb has to be repeated: 连看都没看. 连没看 does not exist.
items.py: tā lián kàn dōu méi kàn jiù bǎ dōng xi mǎi le

items.zh: 房东连电话都不接。
items.en: The landlord doesn't even answer the phone.
items.why: The 连 phrase comes first, then 都, then 不 and the verb. 不 cannot be placed between 连 and 都.
items.py: fáng dōng lián diàn huà dōu bù jiē

items.q: 我连一分钱___没带，怎么买东西？
items.zh: 我连一分钱也没带，怎么买东西？
items.en: I didn't bring even one cent; how can I buy anything?
items.why: 'Not even one' needs 连一分钱 + 也 or 都 + 没带. 才, 就 and 只 do not give the extreme 'not even' meaning.
items.py: wǒ lián yī fēn qián yě méi dài zěn me mǎi dōng xi

items.zh: 我连这个小区的名字都没听说过。
items.en: I haven't even heard the name of this compound.
items.why: The object is pulled in front of the verb with 连, followed by 都, then 没 and 听说过.
items.py: wǒ lián zhè ge xiǎo qū de míng zi dōu méi tīng shuō guò
